def process(wb2020, wb2021, wb2022, wb2023):
    import pandas as pd
    df = pd.concat([wb2020, wb2021, wb2022, wb2023], ignore_index=True)
    # Standardize key fields
    df = df.rename(columns={
        'Beach Name': 'beach_name',
        'Beach Type Description': 'beach_type',
        'Year': 'year',
        'Violation': 'violation'
    })
    df['beach_name'] = df['beach_name'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['beach_type'] = df['beach_type'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    # Violation encoding varies: 'No','NO','Yes','YES', etc.
    v = df['violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    df['is_exceedance'] = v.isin(['YES', 'Y', 'TRUE', 'T', '1'])
    return df[['beach_name','beach_type','year','is_exceedance']]
input.summary: Concatenate 2020-2023 water-body testing tables; standardize beach_name, beach_type, year, and map Violation to boolean is_exceedance (YES-like values treated as exceedance). Keep only relevant columns for exceedance-rate analysis.

def process(fresh_allyears):
    import pandas as pd

    # beaches must appear in every year 2020-2023
    years = {2020, 2021, 2022, 2023}
    by_beach_years = fresh_allyears.groupby('beach_name')['year'].apply(lambda s: set(s.unique()))
    eligible_beaches = by_beach_years[by_beach_years.apply(lambda ys: years.issubset(ys))].index

    out = fresh_allyears[fresh_allyears['beach_name'].isin(eligible_beaches)].copy()
    return out

def process(fresh_measured_all_years):
    import pandas as pd
    df = fresh_measured_all_years.copy()
    # ensure boolean
    df['is_exceedance'] = df['is_exceedance'].astype(bool)

    rates = (
        df.groupby(['beach_name','year'])['is_exceedance']
          .mean()
          .reset_index(name='exceedance_rate')
    )
    overall = (
        df.groupby(['beach_name'])['is_exceedance']
          .mean()
          .reset_index(name='avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023')
    )
    counts = (
        df.groupby(['beach_name','year'])['is_exceedance']
          .size().reset_index(name='n_samples')
    )
    out = rates.merge(counts, on=['beach_name','year'], how='left').merge(overall, on='beach_name', how='left')
    return out.sort_values(['avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023','beach_name','year'], ascending=[False,True,True])

def process(fresh_exceedance_rates):
    import pandas as pd
    # Determine top beach by avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023 (same value repeated per year)
    beach_avg = (fresh_exceedance_rates
                 .groupby('beach_name', as_index=False)
                 .agg(avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023=('avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023','first'),
                      total_samples=('n_samples','sum')))
    beach_avg = beach_avg.sort_values(['avg_exceedance_rate_2020_2023','total_samples','beach_name'], ascending=[False, False, True])
    return beach_avg.head(1)
